required_by: Owner batch 3 (2026-10-08): fixtures for SKIPPED_ATR_NOT_READY, SKIPPED_PRE_CLOSURE, and the ATR14 floor case.
status: DATA_AND_WORKED_PROOF_ONLY -- not wired into tests/ (out of this session's scope)
note: A guard result is a PUBLICATION DECISION, not an outcome. It never enters the section 5 outcome taxonomy and is counted separately.

cases.purpose: SKIPPED_ATR_NOT_READY when fewer than 15 closed M5 bars precede the CHoCH bar.
cases.significance: ATR14 is computed over m5[: choch_index + 1]. With MIN_M5_BARS = 30 overall, an early CHoCH inside the loaded window can still leave the ATR slice short. Counted separately; see BACKLOG B5 on replay-window truncation.

Stricter than c10_stop_policy.compute_c10_stop, which raises INVALID_ATR only for atr < 0 and would accept atr == 0. Without this guard the buffer collapses to the 1-point floor alone on a flat series, and before OD-28 it collapsed to zero -- the exact unreachability LSMC-OD-21 was raised to fix.

cases.purpose: The PROVISIONAL 1-point floor changes the outcome when 0.35 x ATR14 < 1 point.
cases.significance: buffer = max(0.35 x 0.2, 1 x 0.1) = max(0.07, 0.1) = 0.1. The floor widens the stop from 59999.93 to 59999.90, which is what keeps the INVALIDATED window open on this bar. Demonstrates the floor is load-bearing, not decorative.

cases.purpose: SKIPPED_PRE_CLOSURE when fewer than 6 tradable M5 bars remain before a scheduled closure.
cases.significance: Without this guard the LSMC-OD-06 floor of 6 M5 bars would be consumed entirely by the weekend closure, producing a guaranteed EXPIRY_IN_MARKET_CLOSED with zero resolvable bars.

cases.purpose: Exactly 6 tradable M5 bars remaining PUBLISHES (the test is < 6, not <= 6).
cases.significance: The < 6 convention makes the LSMC-OD-06 floor exactly satisfiable in tradable bars, which is the guard's stated purpose. Recorded as BACKLOG B7 in case the inclusive reading was intended.

cases.purpose: Crypto is subject to broker maintenance closures only, and none are defined.

checks.guard: no scheduled closure in the calendar -> never fires

cases.significance: The FX weekly close does not apply to crypto (watch.evaluate_snapshot bypasses fx_market_closed for CRYPTO_SYMBOLS). No broker maintenance calendar exists in this repository, so the guard evaluates vacuously and FAILS OPEN. Recorded as BACKLOG B2, non-blocking.
